title: Pick a label printer
ask: We need a thermal label printer for the packing bench. I've put three options in sources/options.md. Please write me a short brief saying which to buy and why.
background: We send about 60 parcels a day and the courier labels are 100 by 150 mm.
The packing bench computer is a Mac, which has caught us out before.
I have $400 set aside for it.

constraints.text: give your reasons as bullet points, no more than four
compare the options in a table with the columns Option, Price, Works with Mac
none of the sales words "best-in-class", "game-changer" or "no-brainer"
work only from the snapshot, no web lookups
don't contact Brightlabel or any other vendor
name the file you worked from, sources/options.md

start.sources/options.md:
